title: Ten NNSA changes pass bounded object-level diff review
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy and National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: The existing ten scope, budget, cost, schedule, capacity, qualification, and GAO-state events are accepted as source diffs with operating outcomes left null. Denominator: Ten reviewed change events across LAP4, SRPPF, capacity, qualification, and GAO objects.
key_findings: Finding: The existing ten scope, budget, cost, schedule, capacity, qualification, and GAO-state events are accepted as source diffs with operating outcomes left null.
Denominator: Ten reviewed change events across LAP4, SRPPF, capacity, qualification, and GAO objects.
Boundary: Budget change is not implementation.
Boundary: Forecast change is not completion.
Boundary: Accepted source diff is not accepted output.
Next action: Compare later versions only against the same object and definition.
why_it_matters: The record makes change detection, schema migration, observation validation, and object-level source diffs reviewable before publication.
ftfn_relevance: Turns provenance matrices into repeatable review rails.
Keeps rejected joins and unresolved identities explicit.
Separates bounded inserts from operating outcomes, implementation, acceptance, and closure.
evidence_limits: Not publicly acquired does not mean nonexistent, withheld, or never submitted.
FTFN public-source research is not agency contact or a submitted FOIA request.
